query:
UPDATE kanban_tasks SET
            title = CASE WHEN $1 = '' THEN title ELSE NULLIF($2, '')::text END,
            body = CASE WHEN $3 = $4 THEN body ELSE $5 END,
            assignee = CASE WHEN $6 = '' THEN assignee ELSE NULLIF($7, '')::text END,
            channel_id = CASE WHEN $8 = $9 THEN channel_id ELSE NULLIF($10, '')::text END,
            profile = CASE WHEN $11 = '' THEN profile ELSE NULLIF($12, '')::text END,
            priority = CASE WHEN $13 = -999999::bigint THEN priority::bigint ELSE $14 END,
            status = CASE WHEN $15 = '' THEN status ELSE $16 END,
            archived = $17,
            template = CASE WHEN $18 = '' THEN template ELSE NULLIF($19, '')::text END,
            plan = $20,
            workflow_id = CASE WHEN $21 = $22 THEN workflow_id ELSE NULLIF($23, '')::text END,
            board = CASE WHEN $24 = '' THEN board ELSE NULLIF($25, '')::text END,
            position = CASE
                WHEN $26 = -999999 THEN
                    CASE WHEN $27 != '' AND $28 != board THEN 0 ELSE position END
                ELSE $29
            END,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $30
